observations.trace: HairSeed.from_word stores an i32 bit pattern through Seed.from_u64 and word returns it as i32. Look has a public HairSeed; Look.groom expands it into an unconditional Orient seed+9 and several other conditional positive offsets. For i32::MAX, +9 exceeds the signed32 range.
observations.remaining: Original Adler161 records the broader offset family; original delegate377 records the specific +9 cut. Their exact global alias disposition remains open and neither is treated as an independently counted bug. Panic versus wrapping depends on overflow-check configuration; no addition or groom ran.

observations.contract: Random seed reachability by source algebra
observations.trace: Look.random uses its first next_u32, masks with 0x7FFFFFFF and admits i32::MAX. Rng.new XORs a u64 constant, then next_u64 applies wrapping addition, xor-right-shifts and two odd wrapping multipliers before extracting the high32 bits. Each full-width step is a bijection on u64 words, so some input seed produces an output with high32=0x7FFFFFFF; the mask leaves i32::MAX.
observations.remaining: This is a mathematical existence argument, not an executed generator, concrete seed witness, statistical test or product validation. Earlier Adler366 already reported possible random maximum.

observations.trace: Look.random selects one of five numeric codes using explicit weighted arrays and rematches them to generate straight, wavy, loose, curly or coily parameter ranges.
observations.remaining: Original Adler366 and delegate755 already recorded the local numeric choice. It is a closed semantic distinction, but an eventual owner must preserve the selected probability weights, draw count and seeded behavior. No random generation ran.

observations.trace: The hair crate facade declares modules, feature-gated GPU/render exports and public reexports but admits no local values. Look.preset explicitly records the preset the look started from, while its hairdo is independently editable; that is historical provenance, not established redundant current authority.
observations.remaining: Original Lens2 and Lens3 root reads independently inspected the facade without transferring child body coverage or performance claims. The earlier Lens12 delegate read only1–90. No build, test or performance claim is verified.

observations.trace: Look.new default and preset branches choose point counts between8 and160; Look.random clamps increased curl points to at most256. Public count wrappers hold unrestricted usize; GPU conversion and direct public state need separate admission.
observations.remaining: Earlier Adler366 already narrowed ordinary preset point cases. Custom/Serde cases and native bounds remain open. No random or GPU operation ran.
